gone.ask_friend: Have you seen Cheddar lately? Could you talk to him for me?
gone.goodbye_note: Knock knock. ...Never mind. You wouldn't get it anyway. —C

letter.reply: Your joke was terrible. I laughed anyway. I'll come by.

choices.text: Cheddar, I'm sorry. I said things that hurt you, and this part isn't a joke.
Cheddar, I was out of line, and I'm sorry.
Knock knock! ...It's me. Your chef.
P.S. What do you call a kitchen without its funniest customer? Quiet. Way too quiet. ...I'm working on it.
I really hope you come back.
That's all. Take care.

lines.text: New table today. Gotta keep you guessing.
I'll sit... THERE. No wait. There. Final answer.
Table for one very famous mouse, please. Lead the way, [nickname].
I'll take the one closest to the kitchen. ...For the smell. Not you. Mostly the smell.
Usual table, partner. Wait, I don't have a usual table. ...Pick one for me. That's my usual now.
I can find a seat myself.
One Koala-Cola, extra bubbles. Can you add extra bubbles? Try.
What's the loudest drink you've got? I'll have that.
Bubble tea! The pearls are like a snack inside a drink. Genius.
Okay, drink bit: I describe it, you guess. It's brown and fizzy and I love it. ...It's Koala-Cola. You got it, you're amazing.
Bubble tea, please. ...Actually, you know what? What's your favorite? I wanna know what you like.
The usual, partner. Bubble tea, extra pearls, and a straw I can make noises with.
Surprise me! A drink AND a meal. Double mystery.
One Koala-Cola, extra bubbles. Can you add extra bubbles? Try.
Hold on. Is that... bubble tea? On the menu? FINALLY. Do you know how much cola I drank waiting for this? Bubble tea, please!
Koala-Cola. Can you handle that, or is it too complicated?
Water.

before.narration: He slurps the pearls loudly on purpose.

lines.text: Ah. Perfection. Five stars.
Fizzy! You get me.
Fizzy! You get me.

after.narration: He shakes it first. It sprays all over him.

lines.text: Ooh, a mystery drink! I'll allow it.
Fine.
Ladies and gentlemen, Cheddar has ARRIVED. ...It's me. I'm Cheddar. Hi. Nice place. Do you do takeout? Kidding, I'm staying.
Oh, NOW you're open? I came by and it was just me and a closed sign. We had a nice chat. It's a great listener.
Last time was extra crispy. Like, fossil crispy. I'm giving you a second chance because I'm generous.
Okay, I've been thinking about my last meal here. Like, a weird amount. Don't make it weird.
And the mouse enters the building! The crowd goes wild! ...The crowd is you. Go wild.
New seat today. Gotta keep you guessing.
[nickname]! I thought you got kidnapped. I was gonna make posters. They were gonna be so good.
[nickname]! My favorite person in this building. Also the only person in this building. Still counts.
I had a dream you burnt my food and I woke up FURIOUS. Don't let it happen in real life.
Hey. You were gone a while. I, uh... it was weird not coming here. Anyway! Funny story-
Remember when you said "[last_rude_line]"? I laughed. ...It wasn't that funny, actually. Okay! Moving on!
[nickname]! Okay, I have a new bit, but first, how are you? Like, actually?
I sat here because it's the seat closest to the kitchen. ...For the smell. Not because of you. Mostly the smell.
You can't just leave! Who's gonna laugh at my jokes? Mabel? She falls asleep halfway through!
PARTNER! My partner in crime! My co-chef! My- okay I'm out of titles. Hi!
I have a new prank planned and you're helping. Don't argue. You're already in it.
Oh, look who's working today. Lucky me.
Table for one. Don't bother with the small talk.
Thank you, thank you, I'll be here all week. Literally. I'm coming back tomorrow.
Tip's on the table. It's mostly buttons. Kidding! ...Mostly kidding.
Bye, [nickname]! Don't miss me too much. Actually, miss me a normal amount.
Thanks, [name]. ...See? I used your real name. That's how you know I mean it.
Bye, partner! Don't burn anything while I'm gone. Except maybe Mabel's toast. She likes it that way.
Wow. Food. Incredible.
...Wow. Okay. Betrayal. Served on a plate.
Oh, chef, you've outdone yourself! I'd give you a standing ovation but I'm very small.
Solid. Seven out of ten. Eight if you laugh at my next joke.
Ah, I see we're going with charcoal today. Bold. Very bold.
Thanks, [nickname]! This looks great. Like, suspiciously great. Did someone else make this?
Burnt, but made with love. I can taste the love. It tastes like smoke.
[nickname], you did it again. You're like a food wizard. A fizzard. ...No. Not my best.
Wow. Food. Incredible.
Wanna hear a secret? I hid something in this restaurant. Don't look. ...You're gonna look.
Rate my chewing. Out of ten. Be honest. Actually don't.
I have thirteen siblings. Thirteen. Dinner at my house was a contact sport.
Mabel thinks I'm her grandson. I'm not. I don't correct her. ...Okay, I'm kind of her grandson now.
I don't have to be 'on' here. You know how rare that is?
You know you're my favorite chef in the whole world, right? And I've eaten at, like, four places.
Did I ask for a visit? Pretty sure I didn't.
Okay, okay, don't tell me the menu. I'm gonna guess. ...Is it soup? It's soup, isn't it.

choices.text: You can order whatever you like. Take your time.
choices.reply: Aw, look at you being all nice. Suspicious. I'll have the [dish].

choices.text: It's actually all soup. Every dish. Soup restaurant.
choices.reply: I KNEW it. Give me the soupiest soup you've got.

choices.text: Here's the menu.
choices.reply: Booooring. Fine. The [dish].

choices.text: Just order. You're not funny.
choices.reply: Ooh, ROASTED! Okay, chef! The [dish].

lines.text: Let me guess, you're gonna recommend the [cheese dish]. Because I'm a mouse. Named Cheddar. Classic.

choices.text: I'd rather know what you actually like.
choices.reply: ...Huh. Nobody asks that. The [dish], I guess.

choices.text: No way. Cheese is for amateurs.
choices.reply: FINALLY. A chef who gets it.

choices.text: The [cheese dish] is popular.
choices.reply: Yeah, yeah. Everyone says that.

choices.text: You're a mouse. Just eat the cheese.
choices.reply: Ha. Never heard that one before.

lines.text: Okay, new bit. You describe a dish without saying its name, and I guess. Go.

choices.text: It's warm, it's cozy, it's perfect for you.
choices.reply: Aww. Okay, that's cheating, but I'll allow it. The [dish].

choices.text: It's crunchy, it's mysterious, and it is NOT cheese.
choices.reply: I'll take it, sight unseen. Best bit ever.

choices.text: I'm kind of busy. Just order.
choices.reply: Ugh. Fine. The [dish].

choices.text: Your bits are getting old.
choices.reply: ...Wow. Okay. The [dish].

lines.text: Can I tell you something kinda weird? You're the first person who asked what I like instead of just handing me cheese. ...That's it. That's the thing. Ha. Order time!

choices.text: Of course I asked. You matter to me.
choices.reply: ...Okay. Okay! Wow. The [dish], please. I need to eat my feelings.

choices.text: I'll never hand you cheese. That's my promise.
choices.reply: Put it in writing. Laminate it.

choices.text: It's just good service.
choices.reply: Ha. Right. Sure.

choices.text: Don't make it weird.
choices.reply: ...Yeah. Sorry. Forget I said it.

lines.text: Real talk, then bit. Real talk: I'm really glad this place exists. Bit: I'll have one of everything. Kidding. The [dish].

choices.text: I'm really glad you exist.
choices.reply: ...You can't follow my real talk with BETTER real talk. That's illegal.

choices.text: One of everything, coming right up. Hope you're hungry.
choices.reply: Wait, no, I was kidding— ...actually, let's see where this goes.

choices.text: Good to hear. Coming right up.
choices.reply: Yes, chef!

choices.text: Can you just order like a normal person?
choices.reply: ...I thought we were past this.

lines.text: I'll have the [dish]. Try not to set it on fire. Or do. Whatever.
[dish].
Tell me a joke. Any joke. I've been doing all the work here.

choices.text: I'm not funny like you, but I like hearing yours.
choices.reply: ...Okay, that was nice. Don't do that. I'll get emotional in front of my food.

choices.text: Why did the mouse cross the road? To steal my job as the funny one.
I don't really do jokes.
choices.reply: Tragic. Truly.

choices.text: You're the joke.
choices.reply: ...Ha. Good one.

lines.text: At home, if I wasn't being funny, nobody looked at me. Thirteen siblings. You had to earn the spotlight.

choices.text: You don't have to earn it here.
choices.reply: ...Don't say stuff like that while I'm chewing.

choices.text: Well, here you're the headliner.
choices.reply: Headliner! Put my name in lights!

choices.text: Sounds exhausting. You're exhausting.
choices.reply: ...Yeah. I've heard.

lines.text: Can I just... sit here for a minute without doing a bit? Is that allowed?

choices.text: (Sit with him quietly.)
(Leave him to it.)

lines.text: Surprise me, [nickname]. Shock me. Rock my world.

favorite.text: This is my FAVORITE. Are you reading my diary? I don't have a diary. Are you reading my mind?

other.text: Ooh, a mystery! I love a mystery.

lines.text: Okay, I've been calling you 'chef' for weeks. What's your actual name? ...[name]. Cool. Too normal, though. You need a nickname.

choices.text: Captain Spatula
The Stove Whisperer
Chef Boss
Just [name] is fine.
choices.reply: Wow. Okay. Fine. [name] it is. ...Captain Spatula was RIGHT there.

lines.text: [restaurant]! Ooh, I like that name. Very classy. Almost as classy as me.
Wow, [restaurant]. Officially my favorite restaurant. Don't tell the other three.
Wow, [restaurant] is my favorite! Don't tell my mom. She thinks her kitchen is.
That bear with the patches laughed at my joke today. Like, really laughed. He has a great laugh. Does he know that?
Yeah, it's Cheddar. Delivery. Don't get excited.
It's me. Ordering from over here, where it's safe.
...Okay, that one got me. Doesn't mean we're cool. [dish].
[dish]. Hold the attitude.
[dish]. Five stars for the delivery duck. Zero for the chef.
[dish]. No cheese. You'd know that if you'd listened.
That's it. Bye.

choices.text: (Draw on his bag: a tiny mouse in a chef's hat, crying into the soup. "Sorry I was a jerk. Chef out.")
(Tuck a note in his bag: "I'm sorry. No joke. I mean it.")
(Just send the food.)
(Tuck a note in the bag: "Here's some extra cheese. You love cheese.")
choices.quote: Here's some extra cheese. You love cheese.

lines.text: Partner! No order. I just called to say... hi. That's it. That's the whole call. Okay bye!
So. I had a bit planned for this. A whole thing. I forgot it on the way here.

choices.text: I'm sorry. I said things that really hurt you.
choices.reply: Yeah. You did. ...Thanks for saying it without a joke.

choices.text: I missed your jokes. I missed you.
choices.reply: ...Okay, that's a low blow. In a nice way.

choices.text: Knock knock.
Your chef, who's really sorry.
choices.reply: Your chef, who's really sorry who? ...No, wait, that's not how it... HA. Okay. Okay, that got me.

lines.text: Fine. Starting over. Hi, I'm Cheddar. I hate cheese. Nice to meet you.
Wait. What's YOUR favorite food? You always ask me. Nobody asks you.
lines.reply: [player_favorite]. Got it. Locked in the vault. The vault is my brain. It's a small vault.

lines.text: Stitches showed me the apron he made you. Okay, I'm jealous. I can't sew. I can make you a sign, though.
Wait, is that Grandma's bell? She gave you the BELL? ...She's never even let me TOUCH the bell.
Ta-da! The Cheddar-mobile. Beach run? I know a secret spot. Very secret. Don't tell the gulls.
Hop in, [nickname]! Seatbelts on. Snacks optional. Snacks strongly encouraged.
Beach? Beach. Come on, the waves are doing their thing and I'm not watching it alone.
You look like someone who needs sand in their shoes. Trust me, I'm a professional.
There's my favorite co-pilot. Same spot as always?
I kept the passenger seat warm. Okay, I sat in it. Same thing. Beach?
Road trip! [name], you coming or what?
[nickname]! Car's leaving. Beach. You, me, the gang. Yes?
Can't do the beach without you, [name]. Well, I could. But I won't. Coming?
So I said to the gull, 'That's MY fry.' And the gull said nothing, because it's a gull. I won that one.
Fun fact: I've never once gotten lost. I have taken many surprise routes.
If anyone asks, the dent was already there.
Windows down! Smell that? That's adventure. Also, a little bit, cheese. That's me.
Can I tell you something? This drive's my favorite part of the week. Don't make it weird.
Grandma Mabel says I drive like a squirrel with a deadline. I take that as a compliment.
You know what's funny? I used to do this drive alone. It was quieter. It was worse.
I'm naming this road after us. Cheddar-and-[nickname] Highway. Rolls right off the tongue.
Look at those stars. Okay, I can't name any of them. That one's Gary.
Who's up this early? Us. Legends. Sleepy, sleepy legends.
Look at that sky. It's showing off. I respect that.
And we're here! Rods on the pier, shells on the sand, and I'll be over here looking dashing.
Welcome back to Cheddar Cove. Population: us.
Home time? Aw. Okay. Everybody in! Count off. ...Close enough.
Already? ...Fine. But we're coming back. That's a promise, [nickname].
Catch anything? If it's a boot, I want it. I'm starting a collection.
The trick to the beach is to look relaxed. Watch. ...Am I doing it?
I come here when the restaurant's been loud. In a good way. It's nice to hear nothing for a bit.
Grandma taught me to skip stones out here. I'm terrible. Six skips. Don't check.
Thanks for coming out here with me. I mean it. ...Okay, that's enough feelings, go fish.
Someday I'm opening a snack shack right here. You'd be head chef, obviously.
Shh. Listen. That's the waves. ...Okay, you can talk again.
(A note on the windshield: 'Car's resting. So am I. Maybe some other time. —C')
(A note on the windshield: 'Out of gas. And out of patience. —C')
(A note on the windshield: 'Not taking passengers.')
(The car is locked and dusty. There's no note this time.)
The car? Yeah, it's... in the shop. Don't worry about it.
Beach trips are canceled. Indefinitely. Weather. ...Emotional weather.
Don't ask about the car.
I drove past the beach the other day. Didn't stop. It's not as fun on your own.
